scenario.summary: Guest opens a bundle whose first included product is DisablePurchasing and has a typical lead time, and checks the lead time row.
steps: Search the bundle SKU and open the first result
Verify included product 1's 'Typical Lead Time:\n<n> Days'
assertions: Included product 1's lead time text equals 'Typical Lead Time:\n<child1LeadTime> Days'
evidence: Method comment: Z10-TC-8863 lead time for a DisablePurchasing out-of-stock child.

Params: child1State tracked, leadTimeChild 1. The recorded child 1 z-2671004 is DisablePurchasing with stock 2 = its bundle quantity (tracked, not out of stock); the key has no 'DisablePurchasing in any stock' state, so the recorded state is pinned.
IncludedProductN names locate the child row by its name (XPath //*[text()='<name>']): data, product.childNName (children in PDP order).

The lead-time row is composed 'Typical Lead Time:\n<n> Days' (verifyTypicalLeadTimeForBundleProductChild compares the text); data without output, built by the migrated test from product.child1LeadTime.

New key PRODUCT_BUNDLE_CHILD_STOCK_STATES (pending, proposed with this module): bundle whose children in PDP order (association display order) are in the stock states the test checks: untracked = AllowBackOrdering or DontTrackInventory, tracked = DisablePurchasing with store stock >= bundle qty, outOfStock = DisablePurchasing with store stock below it, available = untracked or tracked; leadTimeChild = position of a child with a TypicalLeadTime. Outputs childN Sku/Name/BundleQty/StockOption/StoreQty/LeadTime/State, inStockMessage and outOfStockMessage (ZnodePortal InStockMsg / OutOfStockMsg). No approved key returns child stock options, child stock or lead times.

DB (bin/tda rows 2026-11-06): z-345678 is an active BundleProduct (PimProductId 868); its active children in PDP order are z-2671004 'DeWalt 6-1/2 in. 36-Tooth Aluminum Cutting Blade' (bundle qty 2, DisablePurchasing, stock 2 in warehouse 2), z-2672001 'DeWalt 12 in. Dual-Port Rip Guide' (bundle qty 1, DisablePurchasing) and z-2672003 (bundle qty 1, DisablePurchasing), so the available bundle quantity is floor(2 / 2) = 1. The shoppingCart entry bundleProductVerifyIncludedQuantitiesAndExceedingProductQuantityErrorMessage resolves the same SKU with PRODUCT_BUNDLE_QUANTITY_LIMITED_IN_STOCK.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware; centralizedLoginEnabled=no), the same store as the Playwright webstore entries. Guest flow, no sign-in.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); product facts come from bin/tda rows (2026-11-06) and the approved Playwright pdp entries.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
